title: DispatchSpec
description: The single argument to ExecutionBackend.run(). Backend selection is a pure function of routing_decision.location x routing_decision.isolation. Enum values mirror the vocabulary pinned by pin-isolation-contract (dg-05), which remains authoritative.

worktree_root.description: Local lanes only; write scope for the sandbox renderer.

env_allowlist.description: Names of variables permitted in the child environment. Values are resolved backend-side; inheritance is never implicit (spec: vendor-dispatch, explicit allowlist).

credential_grants.description: Leaf credentials the broker injects. MUST NOT reference the secret store itself (spec: credential-brokering, leaf-credential invariant).

scope.description: e.g. repo full name, spend cap, ledger scopes.

egress_policy_version.description: policy_version of the NetworkPolicyExport this dispatch's egress was rendered from.

wall_clock_bound_seconds.description: Remote backends: provider auto-stop bound (spec: cloud-sandbox-execution, bounded lifecycle).
